task.ques: Find the result of the latest basketball game between the Miami Heat and the New York Knicks, including the final score and top rebounder from the match.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The New York Knicks defeated the Miami Heat 132–125 in their latest matchup, on December 21, 2025. Miami’s Kel’el Ware led all players with 19 rebounds.

Evidence: ESPN’s Gamecast lists the final score and rebound leaders: Ware 19, Josh Hart 10 (https://www.espn.com/nba/game/_/gameId/401810253/heat-knicks). The Miami schedule identifies December 21 as their last completed meeting (https://www.espn.com/nba/team/schedule/_/name/mia/season/2026); Miami’s 2026–27 games through October 28, 2026 include no later completed Knicks matchup (https://www.espn.com/nba/team/_/name/mia/miami-heat).

Screenshot: final.png shows ESPN’s dated recap, final scoreboard, and Ware’s 19 rebounds: https://www.espn.com/nba/recap/_/gameId/401810253
